versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Ecommerce Product Copywriter skill.
- Generates compelling, SEO-optimized product descriptions for platforms like Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, eBay, and more.
- Supports multiple description frameworks (feature-benefit, problem-solution, story-driven, concise/ads).
- Outputs include standard, long-form, short-form, platform-specific, and multi-language descriptions.
- Provides easy-to-follow input requirements, output templates, and example transformations for quick adoption.
- Includes copywriting analysis (readability, SEO score, emotional appeal, CTA strength, conversion potential) and alternative description versions.
